events.name: Tottenham Hotspur v Crystal Palace
events.selectedSentence: Tottenham's first full De Zerbi season against Crystal Palace's Pierre Sage transition: one result will move two very different season stories.
events.fullSpiel: Tottenham Hotspur arrives with 0W-3D-3L, while Crystal Palace brings 1W-1D-3L. Tottenham began Roberto De Zerbi's first full season with a rebuilt ball-playing defence and midfield intended to support his aggressive attacking model. Crystal Palace retained a three-at-the-back shape under new coach Pierre Sage while shifting toward more possession and build-up through Adam Wharton. That makes this fixture a direct test of a new ball-playing defence under an attacking coach against a new build-from-the-back version of their established shape, and the next result will advance both season threads.

events.name: Aston Villa v Fulham
events.selectedSentence: Aston Villa's post-Europa rebuild against Fulham's first post-Marco Silva season: one result will move two very different season stories.
events.fullSpiel: Aston Villa arrives with 1W-2D-3L, while Fulham brings 0W-2D-4L. Aston Villa enter a new cycle after finishing fourth and winning the Europa League, with several senior starters leaving during the summer. Fulham started a new era after Marco Silva's five-year tenure, with Alvaro Arbeloa installing a width-heavy attacking structure. That makes this fixture a direct test of a new midfield and defensive spine against Alvaro Arbeloa's wide overloads, and the next result will advance both season threads.
